body.condition: For every cohort \(s\) and \(P\)-almost every realized \(z_0\), the conditional law given \(z_0\) of the design sequence \((X_{st})_{t=1}^{T}\) has beta-mixing coefficients \(\beta_s(k\mid z_0)\) satisfying \(\beta_s(k\mid z_0)\le\beta_0\rho_0^k\) for every \(k\ge1\).

novel.justification: The mixing envelope is imposed on the design sequence after conditioning on the realized event query, while response dependence within a unit history remains unrestricted.
